items.question: What is the tape-in hair extension system?
items.answer: It is a hair lengthening technique, involving the application of portions of natural hair to give an effect of length and volume.

items.question: How long do hair extensions last?
items.answer: They can last an average of 6 months to 2 years with proper care.

items.question: How to take care of your hair extensions?
items.answer: Use specific products, avoid excessive heat, and maintain them regularly, every 3 months at most.

items.question: Can I do physical activities with hair extensions?
items.answer: Yes, no problem. Just keep the hair dry and tied up to avoid tangling.
